title: Docs: agent-mailboxes.md says send and acknowledge keep their existing waits, but their participant-row check now has the 5 s connection cap
outcome: docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md states that every mailbox interaction's participant-row check and repair (ensure_mailbox_session_active → reactivate_session_rows_timed) is subject to the 5 s connection-admission cap and can fail typed Retryable, and that only the store work of send and acknowledge keeps its earlier waits.
